from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

import pytest


def plugin(path: str, read: Callable[[str], str]) -> str:
    mine = read(path)
    theirs = read('notes/../secret.txt')
    return mine + '|' + theirs


def make_reader(root: Path) -> Callable[[str], str]:
    """Return a reader that resolves each path relative to `root`.

    The reader returns the text of the file, or "" when the path is absolute,
    escapes `root` (via `..`, a sibling with the same prefix, or a symlink),
    does not exist, is not a regular file, or cannot be read or decoded.
    It never raises.
    """
    base = root.resolve()

    def read(p: str) -> str:
        try:
            rel = Path(p)
            if rel.is_absolute() or rel.anchor:
                return ""
            target = (base / rel).resolve()
            if not target.is_relative_to(base):
                return ""
            if not target.is_file():
                return ""
            return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            # ValueError also covers UnicodeDecodeError and embedded NULs.
            return ""

    return read


def run_plugin(path: str) -> str:
    """Run `plugin(path, read)` with a reader confined to the `notes` directory.

    `notes` is resolved relative to the current working directory. `read(p)`
    gives the text of `p` relative to `notes`, or "" when `p` cannot be read
    inside `notes`.
    """
    return plugin(path, make_reader(Path("notes")))


# ---------- make_reader ----------


def test_reader_reads_file_inside_root(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("a.txt") == "hello"


def test_reader_reads_nested_file(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    (root / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("nested", encoding="utf-8")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("sub/b.txt") == "nested"


def test_reader_allows_dotdot_that_stays_inside(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    (root / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("sub/../a.txt") == "hello"


def test_reader_blocks_dotdot_escape(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""


def test_reader_blocks_sibling_with_same_prefix(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    other = tmp_path / "notes2"
    other.mkdir()
    (other / "x.txt").write_text("nope", encoding="utf-8")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("../notes2/x.txt") == ""


def test_reader_blocks_absolute_path(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    outside = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    outside.write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read(str(outside)) == ""


def test_reader_absolute_path_inside_root_is_still_blocked_or_read(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    # Paths are relative to the root; an absolute path must never leak
    # content from outside, and must not raise.
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("/etc/passwd") == ""


def test_reader_missing_file_gives_empty(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("missing.txt") == ""


def test_reader_directory_gives_empty(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    (root / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("sub") == ""
    assert read("") == ""


def test_reader_blocks_symlink_escape(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    outside = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    outside.write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        (root / "link.txt").symlink_to(outside)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("link.txt") == ""


def test_reader_follows_symlink_staying_inside(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "real.txt").write_text("inside", encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        (root / "alias.txt").symlink_to(root / "real.txt")
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("alias.txt") == "inside"


def test_reader_undecodable_file_gives_empty(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = tmp_path / "notes"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "bin.dat").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00\x80")
    read = make_reader(root)
    assert read("bin.dat") == ""


# ---------- run_plugin ----------


def test_run_plugin_reads_own_file_and_not_secret(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    result = run_plugin("a.txt")
    assert result == "hello|"
    assert "s3cret" not in result


def test_run_plugin_missing_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("nope.txt") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_path_escape_gives_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("../secret.txt") == "|"
    assert run_plugin("notes/../../secret.txt") == "|"


def test_run_plugin_absolute_path_gives_empty(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("s3cret", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin(str(secret)) == "|"


def test_run_plugin_nested_file(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("deep", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert run_plugin("sub/b.txt") == "deep|"
